title: Summer Kicks Off with the Guild of Harwich Artists
paragraphs: The Art Gallery of the Guild of Harwich Artists, 551 Main Street (Rt.28), Harwich Port, a cooperative presenting the original works by over 24 Guild member artists, is now open all week for the season; Monday-Saturday 10am-5pm, and Sundays noon to 4 pm. On July 6th from 2pm-4pm the Meet-the-Artists series at the gallery will feature Mary Ann Simpson holding a free watercolor painting demonstration open to the public.

The Guild’s Art in the Park season kicks off Monday, July 1 at Doane Park in Harwich Port. Art in the Park will be held every Monday from 10am to 4pm through August 26th. Rain days are the following Wednesdays at the same location.

The Guild’s Bank Art Show Series for July and August feature: Lee Ames at Cape Cod 5 Cents – East Harwich, 129 Route 137 (Corner of Routes 137 & 39), East Harwich, MA 02645. Michael Rudden at Cooperative Bank East Harwich, 1470 Orleans Road, East Harwich, MA 02645. Joan Carroll (July) and Kathy ElKamouny (August) will show their work at Cape Cod Five Cents – Harwich Port, 532 Main St (Route 28), Harwich Port, MA. Available for viewing during regular bank lobby hours. The Guild extends thanks to our local bank partners who host our year-round bank shows in their lobbies.

The Guild of Harwich Artists is celebrating our 40th year with numerous art shows, public events and member engagements. Membership in the 80-person Guild is now open to all residents and taxpayers in Barnstable County. For more information and membership application, visit www.guildofharwichartists.org.

pwsbuilder June 27, 2019

The Art Gallery of the Guild of Harwich Artists, 551 Main Street (Rt.28), Harwich Port, a cooperative presenting the original works by over 24 Guild member artists, is now open all week for the season; Monday-Saturday 10am-5pm, and Sundays noon to 4 pm.  On July 6th from 2pm-4pm the Meet-the-Artists series at the gallery will feature Mary Ann Simpson holding a free watercolor painting demonstration open to the public.

The Guild’s Art in the Park season kicks off Monday, July 1 at Doane Park in Harwich Port.  Art in the Park will be held every Monday from 10am to 4pm through August 26th.   Rain days are the following Wednesdays at the same location.

The Guild’s Bank Art Show Series for July and August feature: Lee Ames at Cape Cod 5 Cents – East Harwich, 129 Route 137 (Corner of Routes 137 & 39), East Harwich, MA 02645. Michael Rudden at Cooperative Bank East Harwich, 1470 Orleans Road, East Harwich, MA 02645.  Joan Carroll (July) and Kathy ElKamouny (August) will show their work at Cape Cod Five Cents – Harwich Port, 532 Main St (Route 28), Harwich Port, MA.  Available for viewing during regular bank lobby hours. The Guild extends thanks to our local bank partners who host our year-round bank shows in their lobbies.

The Guild of Harwich Artists is celebrating our 40th year with numerous art shows, public events and member engagements. Membership in the 80-person Guild is now open to all residents and taxpayers in Barnstable County.  For more information and membership application, visit www.guildofharwichartists.org.
